name: ai-crew
description: Hand tasks, missions and reviews to other AI agents (Codex, Gemini, Copilot, Cursor, Qwen, Ollama, a second Claude account or your own) and track their usage and performance. Bring your own logins.

claudeWorkerDir.title: Second Claude account folder
claudeWorkerDir.description: Config folder of an optional second Claude account used as a worker (sign it in with CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=<folder> claude auth login). Leave as is if you have none.

customWorkersFile.title: Custom workers file
customWorkersFile.description: JSON file listing extra workers (any CLI that takes a prompt). See the README for the format.
